title: Robert Jameson's targeting team called in to restart Oscar Flight missiles

tellings.quote: I got a call saying a missile went off alert in Oscar flight.

plain: In 1967, at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a group of nuclear missiles known as Oscar Flight is said to have dropped off alert, meaning they could no longer launch, and a missile targeting team under a man named Robert Jameson was called in to get them working again. The account comes from Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, who passes on what Jameson told him, starting with Jameson's words, "I got a call saying a missile went off alert in Oscar flight." It is told as part of the larger claim that something shut down American nuclear weapons that year.
